title: Transfer learning from Pd to Ni catalysis predicts a ligand for atroposelective coupling
summary: A transfer-learning model combined extensive Pd catalysis data with limited Ni/Sadphos data and predicted a Sadphos ligand that enabled the first reported atroposelective Ni-catalyzed Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling. The abstract reports broad scope, gram-scale synthesis and DFT calculations supporting the mechanistic link between Ni and Pd.
